blurb: Metro Lakes Marina & Rentals offers boat rentals, slips, gas, and a snack shop on Lake Minnetonka. They provide pontoon boats for groups up to 16, jet skis for two persons, and fishing boats with local fishing knowledge. Rentals include life jackets, boat operation instruction, and a lake map with instructional buoy map.
